linkedin:
What if the best remote jobs don't show the salary? 77% of listings hide pay—here's why that could still be your ticket to a USD income.

New data from Loker Dollar: 4,441 active remote jobs, but only 1,000 (23%) disclose compensation. The rest keep it private. That doesn't mean low pay—many employers expect negotiation. So don't filter out jobs without a number.

62% of listings (2,753) are open to applicants anywhere in the world. For Indonesians targeting USD roles, that's a massive opportunity.

Top skills? Communication (39%), AI (12%), Leadership (10%). AI is a fast-growing requirement.

Only one company, Neo Financial, lists a rate: $5 USD/hour for remote bilingual client services. Others like TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether are hiring but don't show pay.

Ready to act? Go to Loker Dollar now, filter for "worldwide remote," and apply to 2,753 roles before they close. Your next USD job might be one click away.

https://lokerdollar.com/en
